## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D endless runner themed around RuneScape: a wizard collects essence, reaches altars to craft runes, and levels Runecrafting to unlock rune types.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Build the game now, with working gameplay.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a standalone HTML canvas game with keyboard and touch controls.
- Rune progression uses RuneScape-like level unlocks, with 12 rune types.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the playable game in `index.html`, including title screen, running/jumping/sliding, essence collection, hazards, altar crafting, XP and levels, rune unlocks, pause/game-over screens, high score persistence, and responsive portrait layout.
- JavaScript syntax check passed with `node --check`.
- Opened the game in Playwright and saved a screenshot at `screenshots/runesprint.jpg`.

### Active
- Validate the latest portrait-layout changes in-browser; viewport was resized to 390×844, but a fresh screenshot and gameplay checks have not yet been done.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Capture and inspect the latest mobile screenshot, then verify touch controls and a short gameplay loop in desktop and portrait views.
2. Check `git status` and report implementation and validation results; changes are currently uncommitted.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.
- `screenshots/runesprint.jpg`: Screenshot from an earlier desktop check; may be stale relative to latest changes.

## Important Context
- `playwright-cli` was used for browser validation; browser was installed after the first launch failed with `Browser "chromium" is not installed`.
- A prior browser console error was only a missing `/favicon.ico` (404).
